# Data Source: stripe_customer_cash_balance_transaction

A change to a customer's cash balance, such as a funding by bank transfer. Look one up by the `customer` and its `id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stripe_customer" "acme" {
  name = "Acme GmbH"
}

data "stripe_customer_cash_balance_transaction" "funding" {
  customer = stripe_customer.acme.id
  id       = "ccsbtxn_123"
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

* `customer` - (Required) The ID of the parent object.
* `id` - (Required) The ID of the customer cash balance transaction to read.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `adjusted_for_overdraft` - See [`adjusted_for_overdraft`](#adjusted_for_overdraft) below.
* `applied_to_payment` - See [`applied_to_payment`](#applied_to_payment) below.
* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `currency` - Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).
* `customer_account` - The ID of an Account representing a customer whose available cash balance changed as a result of this transaction.
* `ending_balance` - The total available cash balance for the specified currency after this transaction was applied. Represented in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal).
* `funded` - See [`funded`](#funded) below.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `net_amount` - The amount by which the cash balance changed, represented in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal). A positive value represents funds being added to the cash balance, a negative value represents funds being removed from the cash balance.
* `refunded_from_payment` - See [`refunded_from_payment`](#refunded_from_payment) below.
* `transferred_to_balance` - See [`transferred_to_balance`](#transferred_to_balance) below.
* `type` - The type of the cash balance transaction. New types may be added in future. See [Customer Balance](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/customer-balance#types) to learn more about these types. Possible values: `adjusted_for_overdraft`, `applied_to_payment`, `funded`, `funding_reversed`, `refunded_from_payment`, `return_canceled`, `return_initiated`, `transferred_to_balance`, `unapplied_from_payment`.
* `unapplied_from_payment` - See [`unapplied_from_payment`](#unapplied_from_payment) below.

<a id="adjusted_for_overdraft"></a>
### `adjusted_for_overdraft`

The `adjusted_for_overdraft` attribute supports:

* `balance_transaction` - The [Balance Transaction](https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance_transactions/object) that corresponds to funds taken out of your Stripe balance.
* `linked_transaction` - The [Cash Balance Transaction](https://docs.stripe.com/api/cash_balance_transactions/object) that brought the customer balance negative, triggering the clawback of funds.

<a id="applied_to_payment"></a>
### `applied_to_payment`

The `applied_to_payment` attribute supports:

* `payment_intent` - The [Payment Intent](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents/object) that funds were applied to.

<a id="funded"></a>
### `funded`

The `funded` attribute supports:

* `bank_transfer` - See [`funded.bank_transfer`](#funded.bank_transfer) below.

<a id="funded.bank_transfer"></a>
### `funded.bank_transfer`

The `funded.bank_transfer` attribute supports:

* `eu_bank_transfer` - See [`funded.bank_transfer.eu_bank_transfer`](#funded.bank_transfer.eu_bank_transfer) below.
* `gb_bank_transfer` - See [`funded.bank_transfer.gb_bank_transfer`](#funded.bank_transfer.gb_bank_transfer) below.
* `jp_bank_transfer` - See [`funded.bank_transfer.jp_bank_transfer`](#funded.bank_transfer.jp_bank_transfer) below.
* `reference` - The user-supplied reference field on the bank transfer.
* `type` - The funding method type used to fund the customer balance. Permitted values include: `eu_bank_transfer`, `gb_bank_transfer`, `jp_bank_transfer`, `mx_bank_transfer`, or `us_bank_transfer`. Possible values: `eu_bank_transfer`, `gb_bank_transfer`, `jp_bank_transfer`, `mx_bank_transfer`, `us_bank_transfer`.
* `us_bank_transfer` - See [`funded.bank_transfer.us_bank_transfer`](#funded.bank_transfer.us_bank_transfer) below.

<a id="funded.bank_transfer.eu_bank_transfer"></a>
### `funded.bank_transfer.eu_bank_transfer`

The `funded.bank_transfer.eu_bank_transfer` attribute supports:

* `bic` - The BIC of the bank of the sender of the funding.
* `iban_last4` - The last 4 digits of the IBAN of the sender of the funding.
* `sender_name` - The full name of the sender, as supplied by the sending bank.

<a id="funded.bank_transfer.gb_bank_transfer"></a>
### `funded.bank_transfer.gb_bank_transfer`

The `funded.bank_transfer.gb_bank_transfer` attribute supports:

* `account_number_last4` - The last 4 digits of the account number of the sender of the funding.
* `sender_name` - The full name of the sender, as supplied by the sending bank.
* `sort_code` - The sort code of the bank of the sender of the funding

<a id="funded.bank_transfer.jp_bank_transfer"></a>
### `funded.bank_transfer.jp_bank_transfer`

The `funded.bank_transfer.jp_bank_transfer` attribute supports:

* `sender_bank` - The name of the bank of the sender of the funding.
* `sender_branch` - The name of the bank branch of the sender of the funding.
* `sender_name` - The full name of the sender, as supplied by the sending bank.

<a id="funded.bank_transfer.us_bank_transfer"></a>
### `funded.bank_transfer.us_bank_transfer`

The `funded.bank_transfer.us_bank_transfer` attribute supports:

* `network` - The banking network used for this funding. Possible values: `ach`, `domestic_wire_us`, `swift`.
* `sender_name` - The full name of the sender, as supplied by the sending bank.

<a id="refunded_from_payment"></a>
### `refunded_from_payment`

The `refunded_from_payment` attribute supports:

* `refund` - The [Refund](https://docs.stripe.com/api/refunds/object) that moved these funds into the customer's cash balance.

<a id="transferred_to_balance"></a>
### `transferred_to_balance`

The `transferred_to_balance` attribute supports:

* `balance_transaction` - The [Balance Transaction](https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance_transactions/object) that corresponds to funds transferred to your Stripe balance.

<a id="unapplied_from_payment"></a>
### `unapplied_from_payment`

The `unapplied_from_payment` attribute supports:

* `payment_intent` - The [Payment Intent](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents/object) that funds were unapplied from.
